title: Local ZITADEL integration and bootstrap
objective: ZITADEL (self-hosted, compose profile) bootstrap creating project, OIDC app, roles, branding and test users; ZITADEL Cloud configuration documented; validation that discovery is reachable and redirect URIs/cookie settings are valid; E2E login against real ZITADEL.
acceptance_criteria: ./dev up --profile identity starts ZITADEL and bootstrap writes local OIDC config
Playwright logs in through real ZITADEL and reaches /dashboard
Identity config validator rejects bad redirect URIs/cookie settings
